description: Ex-RAF XJ645, converted to FGA.73A, ex-Royal Jordanian Air Force 831, gifted to Oman 1975, in SOAF/RAFO service 1975-1993 (ABPic remarks). Gate guard at Seeb air base, marked '831' on the nose gear door in a low-visibility grey scheme. Photographed July 2002 (Bob Green, Thunder & Lightnings), 22 Nov 2012 (Jean Marc Braun, ABPic 'Seeb AFB gate guard') and c.2016 (Mick Pearson, aviationmuseum.eu, which maps it at 23 35 06.5 N 58 16 55.3 E and titles it 'Hunter F.6 831'). No photo dated after 2016 found; presence in 2025-26 unverified. Coordinates are the aviationmuseum.eu map pin.
museum_name: RAFO Seeb Hunter gate guard, Muscat International Airport
